name: Session Info
description: Contributes the SessionInfo tool: the live runtime state of the agent at call time. It shows context fullness as tokens used compared with the window, and the selected effort, reasoning and fast-mode settings. It gives provider quota windows, cumulative token usage and rough cost, the current working directory, and uptime. It is the runtime-state counterpart to ModelInfo, which gives static capabilities. The tool reads stable host data sources directly (session tokens, provider session info, model registry). Thus it needs no provider import and never blocks on the network.

tool.name: SessionInfo
tool.description:
Show the status of this session at this time. The tool gives how full the context is, the turns, the `effort` and the quota limits. It also gives the tokens, the approximate cost in USD, the `cwd` and the time since the start. For the model functions, use `ModelInfo`.

Use it when the user wants to know these values, or to find if your context is too full.
